output.notes: Described DeepSeek-V2 (236B total, 21B active) as primary. DeepSeek-V2-Lite is also given; it does not compress queries, so W^DQ/W^UQ become a single query projection, and it has 64 routed experts. RMSNorm, pre-norm placement and SwiGLU are inherited from DeepSeek 67B through the paper's 'tiny details' sentence. Vocab is left not_stated because the paper gives only an approximate '100K'. Context length is the 4K pretraining length; the model is later extended to 128K with YaRN. The widths of the up-projections (n_h*d_h=16384; W^QR n_h*d_h^R=8192) are derivable from the dimensions but are not written as numbers, so they are not_stated. Rotary pairing, theta, eps, biases and embedding tying are not stated. d_ff reports the per-expert intermediate width.
